S12.01.needs: a signed-in account to see the greeting; the empty area also appears when signed out
S12.01.note: The greeting text comes from packages/platform/utils/src/greeting.ts, outside apps/extension; the cited side_panel.ts line numbers had moved, so the empty state was found at side_panel.ts around the emptyState element.
steps: Sign in and open the AGI side panel beside any page.
Click the "New chat" button (it has no visible text; it is the button with that accessible name).
Look: no earlier messages are shown, the AGI symbol and greeting appear in the empty area, and the message box is ready to type in.

Searched apps/extension/src for suggest, starter, welcome, onboard, intro and tour; the only hits were the in-page action chips (Summarize, Key points) and the saved / shortcuts feature, neither of which is shown on the new-chat screen.

The cited pageActions.ts and in-page-panel/panel.ts chips (Summarize, Key points) belong to the in-page panel on web pages, not to a category setup for the next message.

S12.15.needs: a paid account that includes AGI Work (other plans see a locked AGI Work row)
S12.15.note: The cited side_panel.ts line 13507 is the tab bar (Chat and Computer Use); the agentic entry is the AGI Work row in the model menu, found at side_panel.ts appendWorkModeRow.
steps: Sign in on a paid account that includes AGI Work, open New chat.
Click the "AI Assistant" button at the top of the side panel to open the model menu.
Turn on the "AGI Work" row.
Look: the header shows the "AGI Work" badge and the next message starts agentic work, not plain chat.
S12.15.where: AI Assistant button (header) > AGI Work toggle

S12.18.needs: a signed-in account to see the model list
S12.18.note: The cited side_panel.ts lines are the header build (buildUI) and updateModelBadge; the exact label after choosing a model comes from getModelBadgeLabel and was not traced further.
steps: Sign in and open New chat.
Look at the header button at the top: it reads "AI Assistant" until a model is chosen.
Click the button, choose a model from the list, and close the menu.
Look: the header button now shows that model's name before any message is sent.

labels.text: Start the chat in this project

S12.20.needs: a signed-in account with at least one project
S12.20.note: The project is picked through the @ menu, not a separate picker; the cited side_panel.ts line 11571 is the project chip code.
steps: Sign in with an account that has at least one project, open New chat.
Click the message box and type @. The @ menu opens.
Under the "Projects" heading, click a project (its second line reads "Start the chat in this project").
Look: a header chip reads "Project · <name>" with a × to stop using it, and the next chat is filed under that project.
S12.20.where: Message box > type @ > Projects > project name

S12.21.needs: a signed-in account to see all rows
S12.21.note: The mode explanations are in the model menu, not on the new-chat empty screen, and only AGI Work has an example.
steps: Sign in and open New chat.
Click the "AI Assistant" button at the top to open the model menu.
Read the one-line description under each row: Auto, Quick, Extended thinking and AGI Work.
Look: each mode has a description; only the AGI Work description gives an example (researching a topic and building a report). Compare with Expected, which places this on the new-chat screen.
S12.21.where: AI Assistant button (header) > model menu rows

S12.22.needs: a fresh install or cleared AGI onboarding state
S12.22.note: A separate review notice ("Review" button, which opens the welcome page) can appear before the tour when disclosures have changed; the tour step is in features/side-panel/onboardingPrompt.ts.
steps: Use a fresh install or a profile where AGI onboarding has not finished. On install, a "AGI in Chrome" welcome tab opens.
Open the AGI side panel. A notice titled "Getting started with AGI" appears above the message box, reading "AGI reads a page only when you attach it or ask it to act there."
Click "Next". The notice shows the keyboard shortcut text (or a message to set shortcuts).
Click "Let's go" and look: the notice closes and the side panel is ready for a first chat.
S12.22.where: Side panel (first open) > notice above the message box > Next > Let's go
